role: Declares the mob rasterizer: the mob_model_kind enum of every model raster_mobs.c draws and mob_render_input, the per-entity render state (position, rotations, limb swing, hurt/death, colour, ender dragon animation and beam, ender crystal rotation). Also player_preview, the preview's inputs.

structs.name: mob_model_kind
structs.java: which Render/ModelBase pair the entity class maps to in RenderManager

structs.name: mob_render_input
structs.java: the EntityLivingBase render fields RendererLivingEntity.doRender reads (renderYawOffset, rotationYawHead, rotationPitch, limbSwing, limbSwingAmount, swingProgress, hurtTime, deathTime, isChild) plus per-kind state (sheep colour and sheared, creeper charged and flash, enderman carried block and screaming, slime size, villager profession, ghast shooting, bat hanging, iron golem attack/rose timers, squid tentacle angles, dragon animTime and movement buffer, crystal innerRotation)

notes: Header only; the implementation is raster_mobs.c. Includes raster_entity_quad.h for entity_raster_target. lane/entrender: mob_render_input carries fire_dy, view_yaw, zombie_villager, converting, equip[5] and now.
